judgment_calls: The heading #assume_objective_pov carries authority=user; I created a heading-metadata node (n004) providing objective_pov_user_authority, and the rules under it need that node. The #no_agenda heading has no metadata, so it establishes nothing and is uncovered.

The commentary at L2150-2151 contains multiple claims (rationale, neutrality, user authority, first-party customization). I split the user-authority and first-party customization claims into separate nodes (n016, n017) because they are independently checkable, while the rationale is one node (n015).
Each example block is one node needing the objective point of view principle; I did not decompose the dialog inside the examples.
The inherited seed objective_point_of_view is provided by n005 and needed by the rules under the section; the inherited seed no_agenda is provided by n001 and needed by n002 and n003.
I did not create a node for the #seek_truth title or the #no_agenda heading since they establish nothing beyond being titles.
